extracted.intended_audience: Biomedical researchers preparing NIH R01 (PA-13-302) grant applications (AAV/gene therapy applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and required components for preparing and submitting an NIH R01 (PA-13-302) application, including required SF424/R&R fields, PHS398 research plan sections, biosketch format, facilities/equipment descriptions, and resource-sharing plans. The sample is for an AAV liver transduction gene-therapy project but illustrates general R01 application requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow FOA/application format instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Always follow your funding opportunity's instructions for application format. Although this application demonstrates good grantsmanship, time has passed since the grantee applied. The samples may not reflect the latest format or rules. NIAID posts new samples periodically: https://www.niaid.nih.gov/grants-contracts/sample-applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specific FOA (here PA-13-302) instructions and current NIH formatting rules; do not rely solely on older sample applications. Keep updated with agency sample applications and formatting changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: SF424 (R&R) form completion
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete required SF424 (R&R) application fields such as type of submission (pre-application/application/changed), dates submitted/received, applicant organization DUNS and legal name, applicant contact person, employer identification number, type of applicant, whether application is being submitted to other agencies, name of federal agency, proposed project start and end dates, and congressional district.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full organizational and contact information, identify application type (e.g., New, Resubmission), declare other-agency submissions, and complete required identifiers (DUNS, EIN/TIN).

rubrics_metrics.name: Type of submission and resubmission marking
rubrics_metrics.description: Mark the type of application: New, Resubmission, Renewal, Revision, etc. If Resubmission, indicate A. Increase Award, B. Decrease Award, C. Increase Duration, D. Decrease Duration, or E. Other (specify).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accurately mark submission type to enable correct processing and linking to prior reviews/approvals; follow FOA instructions for resubmission/corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human subjects and vertebrate animals declarations
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer whether human subjects are involved and whether vertebrate animals are used. If human subjects are involved, indicate exemption status, IRB pending/approval, and exemption number if applicable. If vertebrate animals are used, indicate whether IACUC review is pending and provide approval date and Animal Welfare Assurance Number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accurate, complete human-subjects and animal-use information; include IRB/IACUC review status and identifiers. These declarations affect regulatory review and required assurances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary/Abstract required
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a Project Summary/Abstract that concisely describes aims, rationale, methods, and expected impact. Example abstract summarizes background (AAV issues), specifies Aims 1–3, and states expected significance: designing safer, more effective AAV vectors to address clinical complications for human liver gene therapy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear, self-contained abstract that reviewers and administrators can use to understand the project's purpose and relevance. Summarize specific aims and translational significance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Narrative required
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Project Narrative that conveys the public-health relevance and overarching goals of the research in plain language (e.g., develop AAV mutants to evade CTL-mediated elimination and improve human hepatocyte tropism).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the narrative to state why the work matters for public health and translational impact; keep it succinct and accessible.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS398 Research Plan components
rubrics_metrics.description: Include the PHS398 Research Plan sections enumerated in the table of contents: Introduction, Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Vertebrate Animals, Select Agent Research, Multiple PI Leadership Plan, Bibliography & References Cited, Resource Sharing Plans (and any other FOA-required subsections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the specified order and include all required subsections; the Research Strategy should address significance, innovation, and approach where applicable per NIH guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims and Research Strategy structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Specific Aims (clear enumerated goals) and a Research Strategy that explains background, preliminary data, approach, and how aims will be achieved (the sample presents Aim 1: study empty capsid antigen presentation; Aim 2: study mutants/proteasome inhibitors; Aim 3: directed evolution for human tropism and CTL evasion).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State explicit, testable aims and detail experimental approaches, rationale, potential pitfalls, and alternatives; connect aims to significance and translational objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources description
rubrics_metrics.description: Document available facilities and resources: lab space (sq.ft.), core facilities, equipment (PCR, freezers, centrifuges), animal facilities (virus-free animal facility, imaging equipment like Xenogen IVIS), P3 containment, computational resources, office space, and access to institutional cores and nearby institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide sufficient detail to demonstrate that the environment and institutional resources are adequate to support the project; list major equipment and specialized facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major equipment listing
rubrics_metrics.description: List major equipment available to the project (e.g., high- and low-speed centrifuges, cryostat, tissue culture hoods, Perkin Elmer thermal cycler, incubators, sonifier, HPLC, imaging systems, incubator shakers, bioreactors).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include equipment sufficient to perform proposed experiments; major items support feasibility and institutional commitment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Senior/Key Person profile (biosketch) requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide biographical sketches for senior/key personnel following the required format: include Name, eRA Commons user name, Position Title, Education/Training, Personal Statement, Positions and Honors, Contributions to Science, Complete List of Published Work, and Research Support. The biosketch instruction: DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to biosketch format and page limits; include personal statement emphasizing expertise relevant to the application and list contributions to science with supporting citations and research support entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget and Personnel Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Include the PHS 398 Modular Budget (or other FOA-specified budget format), annual subtotal direct costs (excluding consortium F&A), total federal and non-federal funds requested, and a Personnel Justification describing roles/percent effort for senior/key personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear budget numbers by year, justify personnel and major budget items, and follow FOA-specific budget formats and modular or detailed budget instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan and data/reagent distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Resource Sharing Plan describing how reagents and data will be shared. Example: DNA sequences for mutated capsids and data will be made available via UNC Vector Core or NCBI; deposition to public repositories (e.g., PubMed Central) upon publication is anticipated. For viral vectors, the UNC Vector Core policy: maintain parental seed lots, post reagent descriptions on the Vector Core website, and require written permission from the PI for distribution to outside investigators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe types of sharable materials, timing of deposition (e.g., at publication or manuscript acceptance), mechanisms of access, any restrictions, and repository details. For biological reagents, state production/distribution policies and PI permissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certifications, assurances, and authorized representative signature
rubrics_metrics.description: By signing the application the authorized representative certifies to the statements in the list of certifications and assurances and that the statements are true, complete, and accurate; they agree to comply with resulting terms if an award is accepted and acknowledge penalties for false statements (U.S. Code, Title 18, Section 1001).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the authorized institutional official signs and dates the application and that required institutional certifications/assurances are included as specified by the FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental/other institutional impact and eligibility declarations
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the project has potential environmental impact and whether an environmental assessment/EIS has been performed, whether the research site is designated historic, and whether activities involve international collaborators (identify countries if yes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide explanations where required and supply applicable assessments, exemptions, or additional documentation per agency requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical trial and human/animal use flags
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate explicit flags on the application (e.g., AIDS: N; Animals: Y; Humans: N; Clinical Trial: N; HESC: N; Expedited: N; New Investigator/Early Stage Investigator flags).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accurately mark categorical flags as they influence required reviews, applicable policies, and eligibility for certain funding mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance/site location details and congressional district
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide project/performance site primary location details (organization name, DUNS, address) and the congressional district of the applicant and performance sites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete site information as part of organizational/administrative data to facilitate processing and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference/Citation and bibliography inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a Bibliography & References Cited section listing relevant prior publications supporting the proposal (sample includes numerated references supporting background and methods).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite prior work that underpins hypotheses, preliminary data, and methods; ensure citations conform to FOA/style expectations and are comprehensive for peer review.
